description: "Enable a monitor local echo (platformio.ini option monitor_echo)."

# `monitor_echo`

- **Type:** Boolean: `yes` or `no`
- **Multiple values:** No
- **Default:** `no`

Enable a monitor local echo. See [`pio device monitor --echo`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-echo).
